about: Function problems: the locked top, the student's code and the locked bottom, and the one file the judge compiles from them. Each part is cut after its last line and given one newline; an empty part adds nothing. top_lines is the line offset of the student's code, code_lines its length. Read by the Go test on problems.Compose and by the editor's join (V202-34), so the two cannot drift.

cases.name: C++ with a function
Java class Solution and public class Main
no newline at the end of any part
cases.composed:
import sys
def twice(n):
    return 2 * n
print(twice(int(sys.stdin.readline())))

cases.name: blank lines at the end are cut
blank lines at the start of the code are kept
cases.composed:
import sys


def twice(n):
    return 2 * n
print(twice(1))

cases.name: Windows line ends: only the last one of each part changes
cases.composed:
import sys
